title: [Build] Publish new artifact for compiler plugin API

target.summary: Calling runtimeJar(), sourcesJar(), and javadocJar() before publish() fails to register the artifacts with the publication component. Consequently, the publication for kotlin-compiler-plugin-api is missing sources and javadoc JARs, causing Maven Central validation to fail.
notes: faulty jar task configuration called before publish()
publish() call which must precede jar task configuration to register artifacts
